**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) engine at `internal/filter/engine.go`; the CEL expression is compiled to an AST, converted to a dialect-agnostic condition IR (`internal/filter/parser.go`), then rendered to dialect-specific SQL via `internal/filter/render.go`, with each dialect driver calling `filter.AppendConditions()` with its dialect constant (SQLite/MySQL/Postgres) to produce the appropriate SQL fragment with correct placeholders and operators.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the row itself), `memo_share` (via ON DELETE CASCADE), plus recursively deleted comment `memo` rows (and their relations/attachments)

**q28.**

Email async workers (2 goroutines) — event-driven channel consumer, `internal/email/email.go` init()
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` — a full cron-style scheduler package that is never imported or started by the server. Also `server/runner/memopayload/` has a `Runner` struct but is never instantiated as a background runner (only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline).

**q29.** Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (authInterceptor, line 156); token kinds: short-lived HS256 JWT access tokens (Bearer header) and HttpOnly `memos_refresh` cookie for refresh, plus personal access tokens (PAT with `memos_pat_` prefix); backend validation package: `server/auth/` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`)
